summary: Packs four parameters into an argument array, validates/reorders the pack against a version string via ArgumentReorderWrapper, dispatches the pack with mode 4 to sub_5357E0, and on success writes the resulting output pointer to *a2. Cleans up the argument array on every exit path.

Invoke ArgumentReorderWrapper(v8, a113_0, 56) to validate and reorder the packed arguments against the version string a113_0.
If ArgumentReorderWrapper returned non-zero, return that error value immediately without dispatching.
Dispatch the argument array v8 with mode parameter 4 through sub_5357E0.
If sub_5357E0 returned 1 (success), store the parsed result v8[5] into *a2.
Success path: release the argument array via GuardedFunctionCallCleanup(v8).
Failure path: release the argument array via GuardedFunctionCallCleanup(v8), then return -5 unless the sub-dispatch error v7 is non-zero, in which case return v7.
